Title: Rohan and the Family

Cast

1. Rohan - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Shalini - 35 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Ajay - 44 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Rohan stands by the road. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "What's the plan today?"

[Rohan gets into the car.]

Shalini (happily): "How beautiful!"

[Rohan gets on the bus.]

Rohan (excited): "How beautiful!"

[Rohan gets off the school bus.]

Shalini: "That's great!"

[Rohan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Rohan: "Oh wow!"

[Rohan pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Rohan: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Rohan: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan sings a song.]

Shalini: "Oh wow!"

[Rohan smiles at Mother.]

Shalini (laughing): "I knew it!"

[Rohan folds his hands and prays.]

Rohan: "That was fun!"

[Rohan hurts his knee.]

Rohan: "Oh wow!"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Rohan: "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Rohan stands in the living room. Shalini and Ajay stand near him.]

Ajay: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan reads a storybook.]

Ajay: "Oh wow!"

[Rohan studies for his exam.]

Rohan (excited): "Let's see."

[Rohan talks to his father on the phone.]

Shalini: "That's great!"

[Rohan's phone rings and he answers it.]

Rohan: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Rohan types on his laptop.]

Ajay: "Really?"

[Rohan watches cartoons on TV.]

Ajay (softly): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
